title: Boris Vallejo
description: Boris Vallejo was born in Lima, Peru. He arrived in the United States in 1964 and has since established a reputation as one of the top fantasy artists in the world. "Illustrating the droids is always a challenge," Vallejo observes, "since they are generally reactive, rather than active, characters. Having R2-D2 use his metal 'claw' to get them out of a jam adds drama to this painting." 12 books of Vallejo's collected works have been published in the USA, England, France, Germany, Hungary, and the former Soviet Union. His paintings have appeared on everything from drinking glasses to jigsaw puzzles, and a calendar of his work has been published every year for the past 15 years.
